header.notes: Computed by tools/ingest/slcsp.ts from the CMS QHP Landscape Individual Market Medical file for plan year 2027. sha256 is of the raw downloaded zip. slcspAge21 = second-lowest age-21 silver premium in the county (the only silver plan where a county has one), ranked and reported on the essential-health-benefit portion of the premium (premium x "EHB Percent of Total Premium", 26 CFR 1.36B-3(j)). lowestBronzeAge21 (incl. expanded bronze) and lowestGoldAge21 are full listed premiums. Child-only plans excluded; non-tobacco rates. Multiply by the age-curve factor for other ages.

flags.stateAverageAge21: unweighted mean of the county benchmarks (not enrollment- or population-weighted)
